name: aplyca
description: Aplyca's agentic development tooling — the Agentic Development Framework's plugin, aplyca-adf, and the opt-in plugins of its modules (adf-*)

plugins.name: aplyca-adf
plugins.description: The Agentic Development Framework for Claude Code: /adopt and /upgrade install and maintain it in a repository, committed or packaged; /cost-report measures what agent sessions cost. A packaged project also takes the framework's skills, agents, workflows, and guardrail hooks from this plugin, pinned to a release.

plugins.name: adf-docker
plugins.description: The docker module's skill for a packaged install: /adf-docker:dev-env sets up a Docker Compose local environment from verified facts, gives each worktree its own stack, diagnoses one signal-first, and resets it without touching other projects. Turn it on only where the docker module is installed; elsewhere it stops.
